Welcome

I am deeply interested in a world where creativity, innovation, and exploration—both on Earth and in space—serve as pathways to peace and unity among people. I believe that advancing knowledge and fostering collaboration across disciplines can help build a more respectful, values-driven global society.

My background spans healthcare, public health, business, academia, and international global health, providing me with a multidisciplinary perspective on complex global challenges. Through my work, I aim to use knowledge, research, and data-driven approaches to bring people closer together, promote mutual respect, and improve health outcomes across diverse communities.

I am particularly committed to advancing health equity, strengthening public health systems, and supporting culturally relevant approaches to global health practice.

Research & Interests
Global Health Systems
Health Equity and Social Determinants of Health (SDOH)
Tribal Public Health Data Systems
Public Health Surveillance and Data Science
